root_meaning: In R = Q(q), let iota: Q[X] -> R be the canonical polynomial embedding and q = iota(X). Set T_m = product_{i=0}^{m-1}(1-q^(i+1)), with T_0=1. Set B(n,k)=T_n/(T_k*T_(n-k)) when k<=n, and B(n,k)=0 otherwise. For every n,k,l in N and every H in Q[X], if B(n,l) != 0 and B(n,k)=B(n,l)*iota(H), then for every d in N there exists a in N with coeff(H,d)=(a:Q).
